en: Black‑and‑white landscape view of a small village at the base of a steep, flat‑topped rocky hill or mesa covered with pine trees. A church with a small tower and several large houses stand among trees in the middle ground. In the right foreground there is a large tree and what appears to be a pavilion or veranda of a villa. The scene looks rural and tranquil, typical of an early 20th‑century tourist or souvenir postcard. At the top right margin there is a handwritten notation, possibly an archival reference number.
